Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint8_t> pd;
Description:
std::uint8_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined pd (pull-down) 1
bit header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype RVF.
The value range for pd shall be:
0x00...0x01 : valid
0x01...0xFF : not used
For transmission, the value of pd shall be set to the configured value, if it is not provided by the
application.

protected
